prompt: a sewing machine stitching a seam that follows your cursor
statement: This sketch simulates a sewing machine mechanism by creating a dynamic seam that follows the user's cursor movement. The visualization represents a continuous line of stitches that forms as the pointer drags across the canvas. The gold-colored seam traces the exact path of the mouse, with each position recorded as a stitch point. The system maintains only the most recent 200 stitch points to ensure smooth performance while still providing a visible trail. When no motion occurs, the seam remains static, but upon cursor movement, a new dynamic trail forms that responds precisely to user input. The technique uses a simple array to store stitch positions and draws them as a continuous shape, creating an effect that mimics the action of stitching through fabric.
